title: Videos
description: Recordings published to your R2 bucket, streamed through signed links that expire.

delete.title: Delete this video?
delete.body: “{title}” and every file encoded from it are removed from R2. This cannot be undone.

publish.title: Publish a recording
publish.description: FFmpeg encodes the recording on your machine, then the files go straight to R2 and the video appears in this list.

steps.keys: Add an R2 API token with object read and write access to .env.production
steps.publish: Publish the recording; use video:publish:preview for the preview environment
